title: Schema evolution is expressed as a numbered forward-only migration catalog committed in-tree
asA: operator who needs deploys to be reproducible from a git ref
iWant: every schema change to live in an ordered numbered migration catalog next to the store code
soThat: the schema shape at any deployed version can be read directly from the committed catalog and no schema state exists outside version control

acceptanceCriteria.description: The migration catalog exists as a source-tree artifact whose entries carry a monotonic version integer, a description string, and one or more statements. Loading the catalog yields entries in ascending version order with no gaps.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the source tree at any commit that produces a running application
acceptanceCriteria.when: the store facade imports the catalog at boot
acceptanceCriteria.then: the loaded catalog is an ordered sequence whose version integers start at 1 and increase by exactly 1 per entry, and every entry carries a non-empty description and a non-empty statements list

acceptanceCriteria.description: The store facade exposes a schemaVersion read operation whose return value equals the highest version present in the bookkeeping table after the last successful migration run.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the store has been opened and any pending migrations have applied
acceptanceCriteria.when: consumer code calls the schemaVersion read operation
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned integer equals the max value of the bookkeeping table's version column, and matches the max version integer in the loaded catalog

acceptanceCriteria.description: The migration runner writes exactly one bookkeeping row per successfully applied migration, carrying the migration's version integer and an ISO-8601 appliedAt timestamp.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the store opens against a file older than the build's max known version
acceptanceCriteria.then: the bookkeeping table holds one row per applied migration with the appliedAt timestamp set to a value not in the future and not preceding the store-opened event
